title: docs(skills): a stored computed field reads only its own row; name the cross-record and volatile-input warnings

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XXq41wp66SECUDG7GbjTwx5)_

Fixes #32703

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kq962ZC9pPopL7fjJ

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三处教 AI「把 formula 的 `expression` 挪到存储字段上」的技能文字,补上存储计算字段只能读本行字段:读关联记录的值(`record.product.unit_price`)停在本行上次写入时的值,会收到 `stored-expression-cross-record-input` 警告,应保持 `formula`(读时计算,不能汇总)或由关联对象上的 flow 写快照,留作存储的字段用 `os migrate stored-expressions --object OBJECT --field FIELD --changed --apply` 修复漂移;时钟(`now()`、`today()`、`daysFromNow()`、`daysAgo()`)、当前用户、`can()`、`hasCapability()` 定格在写入时刻,收到 `stored-expression-volatile-input` 警告,要保持当前只能用 `formula`(时钟也可用定时 flow)。主句住 `relationships.md` → Computed column,另两处各一句指过去。
- 为什么改:#32529 / #32554 已经让平台在编写时对这两类输入发警告,技能文字没讲,AI 照着写出来就是警告后再改。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字加一个 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset,不动 schema、不动运行时;token 在同文件内删重复内容付清,没有抬任何上限;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 的 Computed column 条目;其次 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 的 Total over a computed value 条目(顺手把「existing rows stay empty … no hosted backfill yet」这句过时说法换成:发布没有填充的行用填充命令)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期三个文件都绿(relationships 4127/4127、field-types 3206/3208、dashboards 6230/6232)。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, Inline Editing, the "Computed column" bullet** (the owner sentence): the stored computed field reads only its own row. A related record's value (`record.product.unit_price`) keeps what it held at this row's last write (warning `stored-expression-cross-record-input`), so it stays a `formula` (read time, not totallable) or a snapshot a flow on the related object writes; a field left stored is repaired with `os migrate stored-expressions --object OBJECT --field FIELD --changed --apply` (the command recomputes a stored expression; a flow-written snapshot declares none, and the backfill refuses it as `--field`). The clock (`now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow()`, `daysAgo()`), the acting user, `can()` and `hasCapability()` are fixed at the write (warning `stored-expression-volatile-input`): a `formula` keeps them current, and for the clock a scheduled flow does too. The bullet's own "the engine computes a stored field's `expression` from the row the write stores and stores the result" is shortened to "the engine computes it from the row the write stores" so the new sentence can lean on it.
- **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `formula` row**: the stored field it points to is now "a stored field of its return type with the same `expression` (...) that reads only its own row (relationships.md → Computed column)".
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, "Total over a computed value"**: "(computed and stored on write, from its own row only: objectstack-data → Relationships → Computed column; rows a publish did not fill: `os migrate stored-expressions --apply`)".
- **`.changeset/32703-skills-stored-expression-input-warnings.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with both declaration lines.

One owner sentence plus two short pointers, not three full sentences, as the order allows (#31112, the lane does not duplicate rules).

## Why

Read on `origin/main` 4bba8b8f:

- `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.ts`: `STORED_EXPRESSION_CROSS_RECORD_INPUT = 'stored-expression-cross-record-input'` and `STORED_EXPRESSION_VOLATILE_INPUT = 'stored-expression-volatile-input'`, both `severity: 'warning'`. The cross-record message names three ways forward: make the field a `formula` (computed on every read, cannot be totalled), a snapshot field written by a flow on the related object, and the scoped repair `os migrate stored-expressions --object OBJECT --field FIELD --changed --apply`. The volatile message names the clock (`now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow()`, `daysAgo()`), the acting user (`current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user`) and permissions (`can()`, `hasCapability()`).
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (both rules' `os explain` text): a warning, not a refusal; unscoped, `--changed` writes every row whose stored value differs (and a clock-reading field always does), which is why the skill spells the scoped command.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-expressions.ts`: fills stored computed fields on rows no write has computed since the field was declared (they hold NULL until each row is next written); `--changed` also recomputes values that differ. This is what made the dashboards bullet's "existing rows stay empty until rewritten, no hosted backfill yet" stale. A publish-mode save, a publish and a package publish fill existing rows at the change (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-expression-fill.ts`; `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` says the command is for a definition changed in a repository and booted), so the bullet names the command for rows a publish did not fill, never "every existing row stays NULL".
- Card pointer from domain:spec#3 (comment 6837754404): the platform warns, no 422; teach the warning, not a refusal. The text says "warning" at both rule ids and never "refused".

## Acceptance notes

- **Token payment, in the same files, no ceiling moved.** `relationships.md` was 4127/4127 and the Computed column bullet grew 377 to 979 bytes (+602, about 150 tokens); paid by deleting text an adjacent line or heading already says: in the line-item example the comments `→ drag-reorder, persisted (auto-hidden col)` (the Sort field bullet), `→ catalog typeahead` and the two `← auto-filled from product.*` (the Catalog auto-fill bullet), `computed, read-only, live` (the Computed column bullet), and the parent's `server roll-up of the line subtotal` (the Computed column bullet's "so the parent `summary` can roll it up"); in the related-list section `// title of the detail-page list` (the `relatedListTitle` sentence under it), "(the same source the lookup picker uses)" and "(ADR-0085)"; in Incorrect vs Correct the `// ObjectStack does not have native many-to-many type` comment (its heading and the `❌ Not a valid field type` comment say it); in the master_detail example `// Delete line items when invoice deleted` (the Delete Behaviors `cascade` row); the junction example's `// Junction: Project Assignment between project and employee` and the tree example's `// Self-reference` (their headings). `field-types.md` was 3208/3208: paid with the blockquote's "Source of truth: `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`." (home: `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` line 13 carries that pointer). `dashboards.md` had 6 headroom: paid with three ADR-0021 asides ("(ADR-0021)", "(ADR-0021 single-form cutover)", "ADR-0021 D2" twice). No eval `expected_output` under `skills/objectstack-{data,ui}/evals/` names any deleted fact (grepped). The `→ live Subtotal/Tax/Total stack` comment stays: `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` points to this section as the home of that behaviour.
- The dashboards bullet's existing-rows clause is corrected in the same edit because this PR rewrites that parenthetical; it now names the fill command for rows a publish did not fill instead of saying there is no backfill.
- No eval added: the order lists an eval as optional and the token budget is spent; the warning text itself ships in the lint finding and `os explain`.

## Verification

Head `d6f5eda4`, base `origin/main` 4bba8b8f. Review rounds: at-tier PASS 6887741759 on 68194c4d (S1 and nits fixed at 34db3fa5), delta PASS on 34db3fa5 (S2 and N4 fixed at d6f5eda4).
